description: Follow the matter's graph from one node, either way along its links, for `depth` hops (1 to 3, default 2): for a claim, the facts it rests on and the documents they come from; for a fact, the claims citing it. Each path lists its `nodes` from the start and the `edges` between them, each edge with its `kind`, `stance`, `decision`, `producer` and `quote` (the exact text it rests on). No node repeats within a path. Filter every hop by `edgeKind`, `stance` or `decision`. At most `limit` paths come back; `truncated` is true when more exist (read fewer hops or filter, or page one hop with `lists.graph.neighbours.list`).

decision.description: Only edges a reviewer has `accepted` or `rejected`, or that are still `proposed`.

depth.description: Hops to walk from the node, 1 to 3; 2 when left out.

edgeKind.description: Only edges of this kind: `cites` (a claim rests on a fact), `sourced-from` (a fact comes from a document passage), `mentions`, `about`.

nodeId.description: The node's id, from a `lists.graph.nodes.list` result or an edge's `from`/`to`.

nodeKind.description: What the node is: `fact` (a list fact), `claim` (a claim found in a verified document) or `document`. Take it from a `lists.graph.nodes.list` result.

stance.description: Only citations with this stance: `supports`, `conflicts`, or `record` (context the verdict rests on).
